agust-ai.name: Agust AI
agust-ai.use: An AI medical assistant on WhatsApp that answers your health questions in simple language. Supports multiple Indian languages. Great for basic health guidance.
howToUse: Open WhatsApp on your phone
Start a chat with Agust AI number
Type or speak your health question
Get simple, easy-to-understand advice

medisafe.name: Medisafe
medisafe.use: A smart reminder app that helps you take medicines on time. Tracks your pills, appointments, and warns about harmful drug combinations. Family members can help monitor.
howToUse: Download Medisafe from Play Store
Add your medicines and timings
Get reminders when it's time to take medicine
Share with family using Medfriend feature

life360.name: Life360
life360.use: Keeps your family safe by showing where everyone is in real-time. Get alerts when family members arrive or leave places. One tap to alert family in emergencies.
howToUse: Download Life360 and create account
Invite family members to join your circle
See everyone's location on the map
Get automatic arrival and departure alerts

where-is-my-train.name: Where is My Train
where-is-my-train.use: Track any Indian train in real-time. Know exactly when your train will arrive or depart. Works even with low or no internet connection. Perfect for daily commuters.
howToUse: Search for your train by name or number
See live location on map
Check arrival time at your station
Set alerts for train updates

bhim-app.name: BHIM App
bhim-app.use: India's official UPI payment app. Send money directly from your bank account. Works even offline using *99# code. Simple, secure, and perfect for beginners.
howToUse: Download BHIM and link your phone number
Verify your bank account
Send money using UPI ID or phone number
Confirm payment with your PIN

matiks.name: Matiks
matiks.use: A fun app to learn and practice math. Offers quizzes at different levels from basic to advanced. Makes math easy to understand with step-by-step explanations.
howToUse: Download Matiks from Play Store
Choose your skill level
Practice with interactive quizzes
Track your progress and earn rewards

umang.name: UMANG
umang.use: A government services app that helps you use many official services in one place. You can check documents, pay bills, book gas, and access services like Aadhaar, PAN, and PF.
howToUse: Download UMANG and open the app
Sign in with your mobile number
Search for the government service you need
Follow the on-screen steps and submit your request
